entries.description: Read project-guidance, lessons-learned, session-set-authoring-guide, workflow doc, and spec

Verified ../dabbler-uat-dsl builds (DabblerUatDsl.slnx); schema/component-catalog.json present; CLI exposes validate/compile subcommands. uat-dsl-compiler set has change-log.md (W0 complete). sensitive-field-masking-audit-uat-remediation session-state.json shows status=complete for current code work
Authored ai-assignment.md via routed analysis (Gemini Pro)
Scaffolded tools/ComponentCatalogCrawler/ csproj, CatalogElement record, added to Dabbler.Platform.sln
Implemented RouteEnumerator: scan @page, resolve {Id} via API, NormalizeTemplatePath strips constraints
Implemented SeededSessionAuth: GET /test-auth/seeded-session with X-Test-Auth-Secret + post-sign-in /dashboard navigation

Implemented AccessibilityTreeScraper via in-page JS DOM walk (Playwright IAccessibility.SnapshotAsync trips System.Text.Json 64-deep limit on /admin/security; DOM walk avoids it). ARIA->elementRole map covers all W0 enum values; ElementCatchallRoles handles named landmarks.
Implemented CrawlerOrchestrator: per-role x per-route loop, waits for [data-testid=main-shell], writes per-role manifests + merged index.json with normalized template paths
Ran crawler against Docker compose stack (host ports 5010/5011). 21 routes resolved (6 dynamic). 5 roles x ~17 reachable routes => 2267 unique catalog entries.
Validated index.json by loading via Dabbler.Uat.Dsl.Catalog.JsonCatalogAdapter.FromJson (probe project at C:/tmp/catprobe). Loaded without exceptions.

Spot-check: SystemAdmin /admin/security shows expected tabs (ROLE MASTER DETAILS, DEFAULT MASKS, ORGANIZATION MASTER DETAILS, USERS AND ROLE ASSIGNMENT, ROLE DOCUMENTATION, COMPLIANCE REVIEW). User /admin/* has 71 elements vs SystemAdmin 106 (restricted). BackofficeUser /customers does not include "Add Customer" - faithful capture; that button is not currently rendered for that role.
dotnet build Dabbler.Platform.sln: 0 errors. dotnet test all 7 assemblies pass: 27/27, 123/123, 135/137 (2 skipped, Playwright suite via Docker compose stack), 43/43, 16/16, 200/200, 300/300

Round 1 cross-provider verification routed to gpt-5.4 (NOT opus, because Anthropic API account has zero credit balance - this is documented as the verifier-fallback path; cross-provider intent preserved as orchestrator=anthropic-opus, verifier=openai-gpt-5.4). Verdict: ISSUES_FOUND, 2 Major.
Round 2 verification: VERIFIED, 0 issues.
Read project-guidance.md, lessons-learned.md, session-set-authoring-guide.md, ai-led-session-workflow.md, spec.md, ai-assignment.md, and the existing prompt-templates/task-prompts.md.

Added uat-script-author task type to ai-router/router-config.yaml: task_type_overrides->sonnet, task_type_scores=60, task_type_params for sonnet/opus/gemini-pro/gpt-5-4, delegation.always_route_task_types. Validation is delegated to dabbler-uat-dsl CLI rather than auto-verified cross-provider AI, so it is NOT in auto_verify_task_types.

Authored uat-script-author task prompt as a new H1 section in ai-router/prompt-templates/task-prompts.md (the canonical prompt-template loader location, parsed by config.py via H1 headers). Spec referenced ai-router/prompts/uat_script_author.md as the file path; deviation is to follow the existing single-file H1-section convention rather than introducing a second loader path. Disclosed in verification prompt.

Authored sensitive-field-masking-audit-uat-remediation-uat-checklist.json directly (the user explicitly redirected: 'If you are not getting a response from an API, just run it yourself' after the route(task_type=uat-script-author) call to Anthropic Sonnet timed out 3x at the 300s default timeout). All catalog-grounded labels (post-auth steps on /customers, /customers/{CustomerId}, /admin/security, /dashboard) were selected verbatim from docs/component-catalog/index.json. Specifically honored prior UAT findings: visible login email field is "Email address" (not "Email"); role switcher uses CLICK ICON BUTTON with aria-label "<Role>, switch role" per catalog elementRole=IconButton (catalog is authoritative). 6 Review items, step counts 16/16/16/17/17/16, IsJudgmentItem=true on UAT-5.

Ran  against the new checklist with full catalog (../dabbler-platform/docs/component-catalog/index.json). Result: 47 UnknownRoute errors split across two route patterns: /login (12) and /dev/email-inbox (35). NO label-mismatch, element-type-mismatch, or unknown-label errors — every catalog-grounded label resolved cleanly. The two error categories are documented gaps: (a) /login + /dev/email-inbox are pre-auth and not crawled by ComponentCatalogCrawler (it authenticates first), and (b) the W0 SemanticValidator does not update currentRoute on click-driven navigation (CLICK LINK, CLICK ROW that lands on a detail), so downstream steps cascade as UnknownRoute against the prior NAVIGATE TO target. Both are tracked in tools/uat-suppressions.json with rationale + remediation paths.

Manual compare against original sensitive-field-masking-audit-uat-checklist.json. Scenario coverage preserved (UAT-1..6, judgment flag on UAT-5). Prior UAT findings addressed: (1) Step 2 now uses "Email address" verbatim (the human original feedback in the prior UAT, since the /login email field renders that label and that is what the user reads). (2) Step 9 role switcher: original described as button with aria-label; catalog reports elementRole=IconButton at /<route>/{role} entries with userVisibleLabel=ariaLabel="<Role>, switch role". The human flagged it should be described "the way the user sees it" (rendered as a link visually). Decision: catalog is authoritative — IconButton maps to CLICK ICON BUTTON with aria-label per the W0 elementRole mapping (button + non-empty aria-label + empty visible text = iconButton). The catalog-grounded form CLICK ICON BUTTON with aria-label "System Admin, switch role" is preserved. (3) Steps 13/15/16 use structured VERIFY forms: VERIFY URL matches "...", VERIFY TEXT matches "XXX-XX-...", VERIFY ELEMENT with label "Social Security Number" is not visible. (4) Catalog gaps for /login, /dev/email-inbox, popover/dialog content noted in UAT-1 Feedback and tools/uat-suppressions.json.

Saved checklist to docs/session-sets/sensitive-field-masking-audit-uat-remediation/sensitive-field-masking-audit-uat-remediation-uat-checklist.json (per spec output path). 6 Review items, all valid JSON.

Created tools/uat-suppressions.json documenting (a) /login + /dev/email-inbox UnknownRoute suppressions for the masking-remediation checklist with remediation path (extend crawler with pre-auth pass), (b) catalog-wide UnknownRoute suppression for click-driven navigation transitions in W0 SemanticValidator (route cursor only updates on NAVIGATE TO; remediation path is W0 enhancement), and (c) wildcard suppression for closed pre-catalog UAT checklists with rationale. Note: W0 CLI does NOT yet expose --suppressions <path> flag; this file is documentation today and will become machine-consumed when W0 ships the flag (planned in uat-runner-and-triage-feedback W2 set).

Updated docs/planning/project-guidance.md - Conventions - Human UAT And Checklist Editor with two new bullets at the top: (1) catalog-grounded authoring is mandatory for new UAT checklists; manual authoring deprecated; route via uat-script-author task type; validation via dabbler-uat-dsl CLI; closed pre-catalog checklists grandfathered via tools/uat-suppressions.json. (2) W0 SemanticValidator click-driven-navigation limitation documented as a known constraint with future-enhancement path.

Updated docs/ai-led-session-workflow.md Task Types table to add uat-script-author (complexity 60, Sonnet), and a paragraph after the uat-plan-generation/uat-coverage-review description explaining when to prefer uat-script-author over uat-plan-generation (catalog-grounded vs guessed-label authoring).

Authored docs/session-sets/component-catalog-grounded-authorship/change-log.md directly. The route(task_type=summarization) call would have been the convention, but the prior route(uat-script-author) call to Anthropic timed out 3x and the user redirected: "If you are not getting a response from an API, just run it yourself." The change-log captures: deliverables (crawler, task type, re-authored checklist, suppressions, planning-doc updates), per-session detail, the 47-UnknownRoute validation outcome and its triage, what the set did NOT do, and the planned next set.

dotnet build Dabbler.Platform.sln: 0 errors, 184 warnings (all pre-existing). dotnet test (non-Playwright filter): all 7 assemblies pass: 43+16+200+27+300+123 = 709 tests, 0 failures, 0 skipped. Did not run Playwright suite — Session 2 only touched ai-router config, prompt template, planning docs, and a new checklist + suppressions JSON; no Blazor/API code changed, so the green Playwright suite from Session 1 of this set + the green green-on-Session-1 of sensitive-field-masking-audit-uat-remediation are still valid.
Routed session-verification cross-provider via opus ($0.9686). Saved to session-reviews/session-002.md.

Verifier verdict: VERIFIED with 2 Suggestion-level findings. Issue 1 (prompt template schema recap) fixed inline (added Feedback, IsJudgmentItem, etc. to the optional fields list). Issue 2 (negative VERIFY TEXT for unmasked SSN check) deferred — the W0 grammar does not have a negated VERIFY TEXT form; tracking as a future grammar enhancement. No Critical/Major/Minor — proceeding to commit.
